note: Five seasons of completed matches from ESPN's scoreboard, one row per match, for research that two years of data cannot support: head-to-head depth, pairing effects, and any selection rule that needs a long baseline. Fetched by scripts/espn_seasons.py, which is re-runnable and idempotent. Scores only — no odds, so nothing here can be judged against a price; it measures what happened, never what it was worth.
